capture_scope: Classic TextSystem score-filter branch executed with self-authored fake detector, crop, and recognizer collaborators; no model inference.

input.mock_detector: returned three fixed np.float32 quadrilaterals and elapsed 0.0
input.mock_crop: returned one 2-by-2 uint8 BGR-like array per quadrilateral
input.mock_recognizer: returned three self-authored text/score pairs and elapsed 0.0

upstream.checkout_location: separate external clone outside this repository

execution.model_inference: not invoked; fake collaborators exercised only the classic filter loop

reproducibility.command_template: env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 XDG_CACHE_HOME="$ORACLE_ROOT/cache" PADDLE_HOME="$ORACLE_ROOT/paddle-home" OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH="$ORACLE_ROOT/upstream" "$ORACLE_ROOT/venv/bin/python" "$ORACLE_ROOT/capture_score_filter.py"

limitations: This isolated source capture tests only the score >= drop_score loop with three mocked recognition results and normal-length matching lists.

It does not exercise detector or recognizer inference, a dictionary, real crop pixels, model/tensor ABI, decoded input, malformed input, resource limits, batch mismatch behavior, a Rust implementation, or OCR support.
Normal Rust tests only parse and hash repository files. They do not load a model, run Python, access a network, use a GPU, or inspect PaddleOCR.
